title: Contact Payload
description: An office or person contact. Deliberately source-agnostic: a record scraped from a web page and a record imported from Entra ID / Microsoft Graph have the same shape, so the authoritative source can replace the stopgap without touching anything downstream.

contact_type.description: office = a department or unit (preferred for student-facing routing; stable, no personal data). person = a named individual. queue = a shared inbox or ticket queue.

reports_to_office.description: id of the office contact this person sits in, so a person question can fall back to their office when the person record goes stale.

channels.description: At least one way to make contact. Absent fields mean 'not published', never 'none exists'.

phone.description: E.164 or full dotted form, e.g. 302.857.6261. Never a bare extension.

hours.description: Published service hours. Left null rather than guessed -- office hours are a top-5 student question and a wrong answer sends someone across campus for nothing.

source_authority.description: How this record was obtained. Drives trust and replacement order: a system-of-record import supersedes a web-scrape for the same subject. Surfaced to the student as a freshness caveat when it is 'web-scrape'.

preferred_contact_note.description: Guidance the bot should pass along, e.g. 'email rather than phone for transcript requests'.

aliases.description: What students call this office: 'the bursar', 'financial aid office', 'the registrar'. Official names are rarely what people search.

do_not_publish.description: Set true to keep a record in the repo but out of the index -- e.g. a direct line the person asked not to have surfaced. Enforced at retrieval, not by omission, so the decision is auditable.
